title: New Project Introduction (NPI) Engineer (5-8 Years)
description:
**Job Title: New Project Introduction (NPI) Engineer (5-8 Years)**
**Job Location:**
Ranjangaon, Pune, Maharashtra
  
  
**About Veoneer:**
Veoneer is a world leader, and over the years, Veoneer has delivered more than 1.1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.
  
  
Owned by AIP and headquartered in the U.S. Veoneer has approximately 2,550 employees in 11 countries.
  
  
**What You Will do?**
**Lead New Project Industrialization**

* Drive the successful transfer and launch of Airbag ECU manufacturing projects into the Pune plant.
* Develop and manage project timelines, milestones, deliverables, risks, and mitigation plans from project approval through Start of Production (SOP).
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure project objectives are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and production ramp-up activities.

**Plan Manufacturing Capacity & Resources**

* Assess manufacturing capacity requirements based on customer demand and production forecasts.
* Plan production layouts, floor space, utilities, manpower, and infrastructure required for new projects.
* Coordinate readiness of Production, Quality, Maintenance, Logistics, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* Ensure all manufacturing resources are available and qualified before production launch.

**Manage Equipment Transfer & Localization**

* Identify and evaluate manufacturing equipment, tooling, fixtures, and test systems available across global manufacturing locations.
* Collaborate with global teams to assess equipment capability, utilization, and transfer feasibility.
* Plan and coordinate machine relocation activities, including dismantling, packing, transportation, installation, and commissioning.
* Ensure successful qualification and operational readiness of transferred equipment.

**Coordinate with Global Stakeholders**

* Serve as the primary interface between the Pune plant and global manufacturing sites.
* Collaborate with international project teams, manufacturing engineers, suppliers, logistics partners, and purchasing teams.
* Conduct regular project reviews, status updates, and risk assessments.
* Drive timely closure of project actions, issues, and escalation items.

**Oversee Installation & Production Readiness**

* Coordinate utility readiness, factory setup activities, and equipment installation plans.
* Manage commissioning, equipment qualification, trial builds, and validation activities.
* Ensure production lines, tooling, fixtures, test equipment, and support processes are fully operational before SOP.
* Support pilot builds and manufacturing readiness assessments.

**Drive Risk Management & Project Governance**

* Identify and mitigate risks related to manufacturing transfers, equipment relocation, project timelines, and infrastructure readiness.
* Develop contingency plans and monitor implementation effectiveness.
* Prepare project dashboards, management reports, and launch readiness reviews.
* Support successful customer and internal project launch milestones.

**What Will You Bring?**

* 5-8 years of experience in automotive manufacturing, industrialization, manufacturing transfers, plant setup, or NPI projects.
* Experience managing equipment relocation, installation, commissioning, and production launch activities.

**Technical Expertise**

* Manufacturing project management and industrialization experience.
* Knowledge of automotive manufacturing processes and factory infrastructure requirements.
* Experience with machine installation, commissioning, qualification, and validation.
* Strong understanding of capacity planning, resource planning, and production readiness.
* Proficiency in project planning tools such as MS Project or equivalent.

**Preferred Expertise**

* Airbag ECU, Automotive Electronics, ECU Assembly, or Safety Electronics manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of IATF 16949 and Lean Manufacturing principles.
* Exposure to international manufacturing transfers and localization projects.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong project planning and execution capability.
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across different time zones.
* Strong communication, presentation, and reporting skills.
* Structured problem-solving and risk management approach.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualification:**
**Bachelor's Degree i**
**n relevant any Engineering Stream**

title: Continuous Improvement Manager
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 Eaton announced, on June 11, 20206, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027\. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
   

  

 The Continuous Improvement Manager will manage, plan, coordinate and lead the deployment of the Continuous Improvement Framework, Industry 4\.0, Eaton Lean \& Six Sigma System throughout the Plant facility in support of strategic goals and objectives.
   

  

* Lead the deployment of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Framework, Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4\.0 initiatives across the plant.
* Develop and implement the site Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4\.0 strategy aligned with business objectives and the overall CI vision.
* Drive operational excellence by utilizing Lean and Six Sigma tools to improve productivity, quality, cost, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct operational assessments and identify opportunities for short\-term and long\-term business improvements.
* Lead cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives to achieve plant cost\-out targets.
* Facilitate and lead Kaizen Events, Rapid Improvement Events (RIEs), Needle Mover Projects, and other Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Coach, mentor, and train teams on Lean, Six Sigma, problem\-solving methodologies, and continuous improvement tools.
* Analyze operational performance metrics, conduct management reviews, and develop action plans to close performance gaps.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through talent development, succession planning, and Lean certification programs.
* Develop and execute the annual Continuous Improvement roadmap and calendar aligned with strategic business priorities.
* Monitor plant performance and drive achievement of productivity, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost objectives.
* Perform and validate Lean Six Sigma assessments and ensure timely closure of identified actions.
* Provide regular CI performance, cost savings, and project status updates to plant leadership.
* Support plant expansion, automation, digital transformation, and Industry 4\.0 deployment projects.
* Drive Smart Factory and Digital Manufacturing initiatives, including KPI dashboards, data analytics, and operational performance improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and corporate stakeholders to implement best practices and standardize improvement processes.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, problem\-solving, employee engagement, and operational excellence across the organization.
* Identify and implement opportunities for sustainability, waste reduction, energy efficiency, and resource optimization.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited institution required.
* 10\+ years of experience in Manufacturing and/or Distribution.
* Experience in driving Lean and Six Sigma initiatives, Industry 4\.0
* Prior work experience in different functions is preferred to ensure this CI Manager sees the linkages between functions, impact of functional decisions downstream and how multiple functions work within a value stream.
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt with demonstrated success in driving productivity, quality, cost, delivery, and safety improvements.


**Skills**
* Lean Six Sigma
* Continuous Improvement
* Lean Manufacturing
* Operational Excellence
* Industry 4\.0
* Digital Manufacturing
* Kaizen
* Value Stream Mapping
* Cost Reduction
* Productivity Improvement
* Manufacturing Excellence
* Change Management
* Project Management
* Root Cause Analysis
* Power BI
